editor_notes: EDITOR'S NOTE (legalese commons, 2026-10-19): in the premium schedule of Section 10, this E-Library transcription gives the 2023 premium rate as '3.50%'. That appears to be a transcription error: the schedule otherwise rises every year (2.75%, 3.00%, 3.50%, 4.00%, then 5.00% for 2024 and 2025), and the 2023 rate is generally given as 4.50%. The text below is left exactly as the E-Library shows it; check against the signed copy in the Official Gazette before encoding the 2023 figure.
